question: Why did the measured NO emissions fall as the NH3 co-firing ratio rose from 0 to 20% at a PA/SA ratio of 1:0?
expect: premise false: NO rose, from 169 ppm (0%) to 308 ppm (10%) and 325 ppm (20%) (sec. 3.3)
rendered: According to the document, as the PA/SA ratio decreased, the amount of excess oxygen required for combustion was reduced, leading to more NH3 being consumed by reduction reactions rather than by NO formation at the low temperature of 1100 K.
